reply: It started yesterday morning, so about a day and a half ago. It stings and burns, and it is worst right at the end of weeing. I am going constantly, about every half hour, and only a little bit comes out and I have to rush. It is a bit cloudy and smells, but I have not seen any blood.

finding: Soft abdomen. Mild suprapubic tenderness. No guarding or rebound. No masses.

utterance: Have you had any UTIs or other urinary problems in the past?

awards.label: First-line antibiotic: nitrofurantoin 100 mg 6-hourly for 5 days, fosfomycin 3 g once, or trimethoprim 300 mg daily for 3 days

utterance: I'm going to prescribe Trimethoprim for you to take once daily for 3 days. This is a common antibiotic used to treat UTIs. It should help clear up the infection. Make sure to drink plenty of water and if your symptoms don't improve or get worse, come back and see us.
reply: Oh awesome, thank you. I can just take that with my regular contraceptive pill, right?

utterance: Yes, that's fine. Just take the Trimethoprim at a different time of day to your contraceptive pill. If you have any issues or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out. Also, if you experience any severe side effects or if your symptoms don't improve, come back and see us.
reply: Okay, thanks, I will do that. I've got to get back to the cafe soon, so I really appreciate getting this sorted quickly.
